mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord showed them again to pray over America, over the president and his decisions concerning China and the alliances he is making, and over a shot of stimulus in the arm.
mentions.quote: praying for this shot of stimulus in the arm
mentions.falsify_match: A stimulus programme is introduced.

mentions.claim_text: He says another new virus is coming with talk of plagues and pestilence, that Jesus said in Matthew 24 they would see it, and that they should not be shocked because their redemption draws near.
mentions.quote: this other new virus is coming
mentions.falsify_match: A new pandemic pathogen emerges.

mentions.claim_text: He notes the outbreak is confined to Africa at present and hands over to a named doctor to speak about it.
mentions.quote: it's been confined right now to Africa
mentions.falsify_match: The outbreak spreads beyond Africa.

mentions.claim_text: He says it was not Ebola the way he saw it but like the Black Death, which the Lord said it would be similar to, spread by rats, noting that Ebola is on the scene and there is another virus as well.
mentions.quote: The Lord said it would be similar to the Black Death
mentions.falsify_match: A rodent borne plague outbreak.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurs. He distinguishes what he saw from the Ebola that is actually spreading, which is worth recording.

mentions.claim_text: He notes the president is excited about the economy and the deals struck with China, says he is curious what comes of it, and more curious about when they try something.
mentions.quote: I'm more curious of when they try to
mentions.falsify_match: The China deals hold.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw a red dawn experience again with a crater in the earth that was a building, similar to what happened at Oklahoma City, and prays over major buildings and New York City.
mentions.quote: It looked like something similar to Oklahoma City
mentions.falsify_match: A truck bomb style attack on an American federal building.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw a patriotism coming across America with people singing a patriotic song and a lot of trucks with flags.
mentions.quote: I saw a patriotism coming across America
mentions.falsify_match: A visible surge of patriotic display.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurs. The 250th anniversary was already scheduled, which makes flag displays close to certain.

mentions.claim_text: He says there is an expiration date to what you have been believing for, then reports hearing there is no water three times, and that the Lord said drought and he saw a dust bowl coming.
mentions.quote: There is no water. I heard it three times
mentions.falsify_match: Dust bowl conditions across the American plains.

mentions.claim_text: Told of a drone threat from Cuba, he says he did not realise they had drones, and recalls seeing boats in the Caribbean and named cruise lines.
mentions.quote: I didn't realize they had drones. I didn't either
mentions.falsify_match: A Cuban drone incident against shipping.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurs. He says plainly he did not know Cuba had drones.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw cruise ships off Key West, that people ask why they would do it, and that they were trying to mess with the economy and bring fear, with the drug cartel and people out of Venezuela getting upset.
mentions.quote: they were trying to mess with the economy trying to bring fear
mentions.falsify_match: An attack on a cruise ship near Florida.

mentions.claim_text: He asks the audience to intercede for the children's protection and for the nation, then recalls seeing a named car maker in trouble and a stimulus of twenty four billion dollars.
mentions.quote: I saw Ford was in trouble. And I saw there was a stimulus of 24
mentions.falsify_match: A twenty four billion dollar car industry package.

mentions.claim_text: He compares it to the cash for clunkers scheme of the early 2000s where an old vehicle earned money off a new purchase, and says he saw another attempt at something like it.
mentions.quote: stimulus like it was for cash for clunkers
mentions.falsify_match: A vehicle trade in incentive programme is introduced.
mentions.falsify_miss: None is. He misdates the original scheme, which ran in 2009.

mentions.claim_text: He declares revival and awakening over America, says Jesus is coming soon, and asks listeners to raise their hands so he can release personal revival over their lives.
mentions.quote: I DECLARE REVIVAL. I declare revival and awakening
mentions.falsify_match: A national revival.

mentions.claim_text: He and his co-host discuss the size of a crowd in a shot, agreeing there were a lot of people but that there could have been more.
mentions.quote: there's a lot of people there. Could have been more
mentions.falsify_match: Nothing to match; a comment on footage.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing to miss; no forward content.

mentions.claim_text: He describes a military style boat coming up beside a cruise ship and slapping a briefcase sized device with a sticky substance onto its side.
mentions.quote: They slapped this thing on the side of a cruise ship
mentions.falsify_match: A limpet style attack on a cruise ship.

mentions.claim_text: He says he does not know who it is, that it could be Venezuela or Cuba, and that this is the danger of adding to or taking away from anything because he only saw a boat.
mentions.quote: this is the dangers of adding to and taking away from anything
mentions.falsify_match: An attribution is later established.
mentions.falsify_miss: None is. He declines to name the country rather than guessing, which is the right form.

mentions.claim_text: He prays deliverance over the boats and the oil tankers in the Gulf and the Caribbean, correcting himself from Mediterranean to Caribbean.
mentions.quote: I thank you, Father, for our oil tankers
mentions.falsify_match: An attack on a tanker in those waters.

mentions.claim_text: He thanks God for exposing darkness in Amarillo and Lubbock and on that highway, and works out aloud whether Abilene is on the route.
mentions.quote: exposing the darkness in Amarillo. Exposing the darkness in Lubbock
mentions.falsify_match: A trafficking exposure on that corridor.

mentions.claim_text: Interrupted by his family, he says the Chinese leader asked the American president directly whether he would stand in resistance if they moved.
mentions.quote: Ping asked him directly
mentions.falsify_match: Such an exchange is reported.

mentions.claim_text: He prays blessing over Cuba for the first time in decades, that they liberate the tyrant government, that the secretary of state will slay his tens of thousands and the chameleon his thousands, and that there will be jealousy.
mentions.quote: Rubio will slay his tens of thousands and the chameleon will slay his thousands
mentions.falsify_match: Rubio outperforms the other figure politically.
mentions.falsify_miss: He does not. He uses chameleon here rather than the reptilian reading he elsewhere rejects.

mentions.claim_text: He prays a covering over a named candidate as he says he did over the president, saying God put him in office and the enemy does not want him to fulfil his calling.
mentions.quote: the enemy does not want him to fulfil what God has called him to do
mentions.falsify_match: The candidate wins and serves.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw women who looked like Catholic nuns weeping before the Lord as liberation came to set the Cuban people free, and that the Lord said to keep praying and watch what he is about to do with Cuba.
mentions.quote: they looked like they're Catholic nuns
mentions.falsify_match: A Cuban liberation with a visible religious response.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw a two year window and that the president was trying to keep the dragon at bay by cracking his whip, with China cracking a whip back.
mentions.quote: I saw a two-year window
mentions.falsify_match: China is deterred for two years then moves.

mentions.claim_text: He says the protection he saw was a two year window and that the administration has about two and a half years left, and asks what would be left of it.
mentions.quote: It has about 2 and 1/2 years left
mentions.falsify_match: The deterrence lapses as the term ends.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. The window and the term end together, which makes the two indistinguishable.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees the president wanting to pull back and start to focus on this, and that Taiwan is in the midst of it.
mentions.quote: I see Trump want to pull back
mentions.falsify_match: An American pivot from the Middle East to the Pacific.

mentions.claim_text: He says he was more concerned with people's feelings than with God, that the Lord said fear me not them and corrected him, and that he got rebuked again right then.
mentions.quote: the Lord said fear me not them and he corrected me
mentions.falsify_match: He gives harder material afterwards.
mentions.falsify_miss: He softens it. Worth recording as a rare admission of self censorship.

mentions.claim_text: He plays a clip in which someone says they would probably do something harsh and be met harshly with bad things happening, and that they talked all night about the issue, saying he knows more about Taiwan now.
mentions.quote: they would do something pretty harsh and then they would be met harshly
mentions.falsify_match: A Chinese move met with an American response.

mentions.claim_text: He says that is what he was seeing in the spirit, then the meeting and the interview happened, and that the Lord said we do not need Taiwan because we have our own chips.
mentions.quote: We don't need Taiwan. We have our own chips
mentions.falsify_match: American domestic chip capacity displaces Taiwanese dependence.

mentions.claim_text: He says he has warned many times to watch what China does, that he saw China turning its back on the Ukraine and Russia matter, and asks whether they remember him saying he saw a panda bear.
mentions.quote: I saw China turning their back on the Ukraine Russia thing
mentions.falsify_match: China withdraws support from Russia over Ukraine.

mentions.claim_text: He says the panda was symbolic of people, that he saw it turn its back on Russia and Ukraine and gaze toward Taiwan saying it is our time and they want to take it now, and that this was two or three weeks ago.
mentions.quote: I saw panda turn its back upon Russia and Ukraine
mentions.falsify_match: China pivots from Russia to Taiwan.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw Cuba liberated and made prosperous with the government gone and hotels, churches and blessing set up, and that they pray for named Miami pastors who are already walking by faith.
mentions.quote: liberated Cuba and made them prosperous
mentions.falsify_match: A Cuban political and economic opening.

mentions.claim_text: He describes an evil looking panda wrapped in its flag talking to the dragon and to North Korea, with Taiwan glowing in yellow lights and the panda licking its lips as they gaze at it.
mentions.quote: It's very evil-looking panda. It's wrapped in their flag
mentions.falsify_match: A China and North Korea move on Taiwan.

mentions.claim_text: He thanks God for what was shown and says they will keep praying over it, and that this is where he stopped because it was a good number.
mentions.quote: That's when he stopped. That's why I stopped
mentions.falsify_match: Nothing to match; a note on how the vision ended.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing to miss; no forward content.

mentions.claim_text: He says the dragon has tight claws down in those people, and that this was before he saw the dove, the cardinal, the two black crows and the turtle, which the Lord said were symbolic of different people in Europe.
mentions.quote: it was symbolic of different people in Europe
mentions.falsify_match: The animals resolve to identifiable European figures.
mentions.falsify_miss: They do not, except where he assigns them later.

mentions.claim_text: He plays an official saying it is impossible to change Cuba's economic trajectory while the current people are in charge and that is what will have to change.
mentions.quote: you cannot change the economic trajectory of Cuba
mentions.falsify_match: The Cuban leadership changes.

mentions.claim_text: He says there was more to what he saw about the boxes and the raid on the office and then the man going to Cuba, and that the Lord said to remember Kennedy.
mentions.quote: the Lord said, Remember Kennedy
mentions.falsify_match: A Kennedy era parallel emerges in the Cuba policy.

mentions.claim_text: He notes the agency took pictures of a meeting in Havana with the faces blurred out, that there are people guarding and things going on, and that they showed up just before something.
mentions.quote: they blurred out their faces
mentions.falsify_match: An American covert operation in Cuba is confirmed.

mentions.claim_text: He contrasts the desire for a cottage on a hill, children, a car and a retirement plan with the fact that Jesus is coming and his main mission now is to save the lost.
mentions.quote: his main mission right now is to save that which was lost
mentions.falsify_match: Nothing to match; an exhortation.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing to miss; no forward content.

mentions.claim_text: He says a major move of God and a liberation of the people is coming over Brazil, Venezuela and Colombia where they have been bullied, and that God will use a wrecking ball like the president to wreak havoc.
mentions.quote: God will use a wrecking ball like Trump to come in and wreak havoc
mentions.falsify_match: American intervention in South America followed by religious movements.

mentions.claim_text: He says some people really like him and some really do not, that he is learning, and that he prays for those who are going and expects an amazing time.
mentions.quote: I got some people that really like me, and then I got some that don't
mentions.falsify_match: Nothing to match; a personal remark.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing to miss; no forward content.

mentions.claim_text: He recalls seeing Israel wrapped as a baby with a big tooth and curly hair on top about a year earlier, says he does not know what that was about, and that the Israel baby did not look cute but the America baby did.
mentions.quote: I saw Israel wrapped in a baby, and it had a big tooth
mentions.falsify_match: The image resolves to something identifiable.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not; he says he does not know what the tooth was about.

mentions.claim_text: He adds that the baby had a little bow with an Israeli flag, that America looked like a cute Gerber baby, and that the Israel baby was ugly.
mentions.quote: America looked real cute, like a little Gerber baby
mentions.falsify_match: The contrast resolves to a national outcome.

mentions.claim_text: He thanks God that he is not done with America, asks for fresh air in her cells, and says it will hold no matter how much the tyrant people do.
mentions.quote: You're not done with America yet
mentions.falsify_match: A national renewal.

mentions.claim_text: He prays over the cabinet, the Senate and the House for a shaking from sea to shining sea and from the Gulf to Canada, and calls a major move of God and a shaking unto awakening.
mentions.quote: A SHAKING FROM SEA TO SHINING SEA, FROM THE GULF TO CANADA
mentions.falsify_match: A national upheaval followed by religious growth.

mentions.claim_text: He prays over the president, the vice president, the secretary of state and the nation's leaders that they get the Clarity Act and the Save America Act done, and declares the act done.
mentions.quote: We say the Save America Act is done in the name
mentions.falsify_match: Both acts pass.
mentions.falsify_miss: Either fails. He also says elsewhere that he does not believe the whole act passes.

mentions.claim_text: He describes crowds with American flags at an event, says he sees patriotism coming across the nation again, and then sees a wound coming and an awakening.
mentions.quote: I see a patriotism coming across this nation again. I see a wound
mentions.falsify_match: A national injury followed by a patriotic surge.

mentions.claim_text: He hears a song about the lakes of Minnesota, the hills of Tennessee and the plains of Texas from sea to shining sea playing on the radios, and asks whether it is literal or symbolic.
mentions.quote: From the lakes of Minnesota to the hills of Tennessee
mentions.falsify_match: That song becomes widely played again.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. He asks whether it is symbolic rather than asserting it.

mentions.claim_text: He repeats shaking several times and prays over the water supply and the power grid, saying the grid is highlighted and to pray over the substations in major cities.
mentions.quote: It's highlighted. The power grid, our substations
mentions.falsify_match: A substation attack causing an urban outage.

mentions.claim_text: He says he has seen Iran crippled but sees Iraq growing and flourishing with a few things but much corruption still, and that he is looking into a fall.
mentions.quote: I see Iraq flourishing. Just a few but there's so much corruption still
mentions.falsify_match: Iraqi growth alongside Iranian collapse.

mentions.claim_text: He sees boats and China with darkness on much of it, asks what the boats are, and prays for the Clarity Act to push through and for the wealth of the sinner laid up for the righteous.
mentions.quote: I see the boats. I can see China. There's darkness on so much
mentions.falsify_match: A Chinese naval action.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurs. He asks what the boats are rather than saying.

mentions.claim_text: He says the presence of the Lord is strong and he is grateful, and that he was told to pray over the New York baseball team.
mentions.quote: Pray over I see New York Yank
mentions.falsify_match: An incident at the New York ballpark.

mentions.claim_text: He says he was praying over the 250th and was shown France, and countries honouring America and the president with gifts for the anniversary, and that the Lord said this is a metaphor.
mentions.quote: countries honoring America for the 250th
mentions.falsify_match: Foreign states present anniversary gifts to America.
mentions.falsify_miss: None do. He says the Lord called it a metaphor, which allows a non literal reading.

mentions.claim_text: He says it is going to look like God is cleaning house in the days ahead, in California and on the east coast, and that people the audience have been listening to on video platforms and television will go down.
mentions.quote: It's going to look like God is cleaning house in the days ahead
mentions.falsify_match: A run of scandals bringing down prominent broadcast ministers.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurs. He names nobody, so any fall would be claimed.

mentions.claim_text: He plays a British announcement that ministers will proceed with the introduction of digital identity to modernise how citizens interact with public services, and says they will have to have one.
mentions.quote: the introduction of digital ID that will modernize how citizens interact
mentions.falsify_match: British digital identity becomes mandatory.
mentions.falsify_miss: The scheme is dropped or stays voluntary.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw over Seattle two hands like a grim reaper's with moss growing down them and webbing hanging off, clawing, and describes it as a skeleton of the gods.
mentions.quote: I saw two hands that looked like grand reaper hands
mentions.falsify_match: The image resolves to an identifiable Seattle event.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not; no reading is offered.
